title: Spider cephalothorax
concept: The body of a giant mutant spider seen from above, a lean low carapace.
sheet: Studio product photograph of a single empty crab carapace shell on its own, no legs, no claws, no eyes: a low oval domed shell 1.6 m long and 1.4 m wide, a raised central ridge with a deep pit in the middle, grooves radiating out to a thick rim, coloured dark brown-black like a tarantula, satin lacquered chitin with subtle reddish-brown mottling and a few short stiff bristles. Seen from the front three-quarter above. A single object alone, whole object in frame with generous space around it, plain light grey seamless background, soft even studio light, no floor, no shadows, no text or logos.
notes: Budget: 4,000 triangles, 1K maps. Rigid part on the root; the face mask covers its front.
